2608.21605.title: Generate in the Chart, Not on the Boundary: Function-Symbol Grounding for Hard Constraints in LTN-GANs
2608.21605.paper_summary: Logic Tensor Network-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Networks (LTN-GANs) inject background knowledge by grounding each logical axiom as a predicate and training the generator to raise its satisfaction, a fuzzy truth value in $[0,1]$. Previous LTN-GAN work grounded every constraint this way, at the predicate level, and improved constraint satisfaction. A predicate, however, only scores a sample, so it cannot embed hard structural constraints, rules such as orderings, positivity, and definitional identities that must hold in every generated sample. In this work, we investigate grounding each axiom as a function symbol inside the LTN framework. We compare against the state-of-the-art alternative, a constraint layer that clamps each violating sample onto the feasible boundary and so produces outputs that are always valid. Our investigation shows that a valid sample is not always a realistic one. An inequality is not merely satisfied or violated. It holds by a margin, and a faithful generator should also reproduce the margin's real distribution. We find that the resolution ratio $R$, the data's scale over the margin's spread, is a diagnostic, computable before training, of which constraints a chosen grounding can learn. When $R$ is large, the predicate receives no learning signal, the clamp pushes every sample onto the boundary, and the margin distribution is lost while every standard metric still looks fine. A function symbol avoids both failures, computing the constrained variable rather than scoring it. Together the function symbols form a chart, a coordinate system inside the feasible region, where every sample is valid by construction and the margin is learned like any other quantity.
2608.21605.paper_summary_zh: 邏輯張量網絡增強生成對抗網絡（LTN-GANs）通過將每個邏輯公理作為謂詞進行基礎知識注入，並訓練生成器提高其滿意度，即在 $[0,1]$ 之間的模糊真值。先前的 LTN-GAN 研究以這種方式在謂詞層面上基於每個約束，並改善了約束滿意度。然而，謂詞僅對樣本進行評分，因此無法嵌入硬結構約束，如必須在每個生成樣本中成立的排序、正性和定義身份等規則。在這項工作中，我們調查了在 LTN 框架內將每個公理作為函數符號進行基礎化。我們與最先進的替代方案進行比較，該方案是一個約束層，將每個違規樣本固定在可行邊界上，從而產生始終有效的輸出。我們的研究顯示，有效樣本不一定是現實的樣本。一個不等式不僅僅是滿足或違反。它有一個邊際，忠實的生成器也應該重現邊際的真實分佈。我們發現，解析比率 $R$，即數據的規模與邊際的擴展之比，是一個診斷指標，可以在訓練之前計算出所選擇的基礎化可以學習哪些約束。當 $R$ 很大時，謂詞不接收學習信號，夾緊將每個樣本推到邊界上，邊際分佈也隨之丟失，而每個標準指標仍然看起來良好。函數符號避免了這兩種失敗，計算受約束變量而不是對其進行評分。這些函數符號一起形成了一個圖表，一個在可行區域內的坐標系統，其中每個樣本都是根據構造有效的，邊際也像任何其他數量一樣被學習。
2608.21605.author: Nijesh Upreti et.al.
